fields.Intake — Published:
120 regular MBA seats (official 2026–27 brochure; also official PG course table for 2025–26).
Published numeric intake: 120
fields.Fees — Published: Official revised 2026–27 MBA fee: Semester 1 ₹79,534; Semester 2 ₹66,678; first year ₹1,46,212. Remaining-year fixed schedule unpublished. Inherited ₹2.44 L total withdrawn.
fields.Fee Scope: Published first-year semester charges include ₹7,000 refundable security/library deposits. Net nonrefundable estimate excludes these deposits; gross cash outlay is stated separately. Hostel and mess extra.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT, CMAT / Haryana counselling as notified
fields.Eligibility: Recognised bachelor’s degree of minimum 3 years in any stream with 50% aggregate; 45% for SC/ST candidates of Haryana only. Result-awaited candidates may apply.
fields.Selection Process: University-conducted MBA entrance test, followed by merit-based university counselling.
fields.Application / Vacancy Signal: Official archive posted an MBA sixth-counselling vacant-seat notice on 28 September for 30 September 2026. Historical late-cycle signal; does not establish seats available on 18 October.

₹4.20 L median, Management PG two-year graduates 2024–25, NIRF 2026 table transcribed by Shiksha. Official Management PDF remains inaccessible.
Reported median ₹L: 4.2

Reported highest ₹L: 12.56
